cand.title: SCET 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong official event evidence and credible scientific/education demand mechanism; venue commitment prevents treating it as open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Strongest institutional commercial contacts: Hiba Gerster, MICE Procurement Officer/category manager for MICE, explicitly covering seminars, conferences and hotel accommodation; Fatima Najeh, MICE Procurement Officer/category manager and MICE procurement Head. Their relevance is verified at CERN level, not proof of SCET budget or contract control. Event-specific chairpersons: Gherardo Vita, Patrick Angus Hager, Philipp Böer and Rebecca von Kuk. Use the published TH workshop secretariat, thworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch, for introductions and event-specific routing.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced: 22–25 March 2027, 09:00 on 22 March to 19:00 on 25 March, Europe/Zurich. These are activity dates, not the department page submission date. Within the requested horizon and upcoming as of 16 November 2026. Separate preceding SCET Panorama Lectures: 17–19 March 2027; do not merge them into workshop dates. No official 2028 edition announcement was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied YOTEL specifications: pursue only a conditional room-only or small subgroup lodging role, potentially including attendees of both the lectures and workshop if they confirm a longer stay. Founex is not the CERN campus; no event-specific transfer or booking evidence supports YOTEL. Meeting-room displacement is a poor thesis because the workshop is already at CERN. No resort requirement is published; scientific-campus access and affordability are more relevant than resort amenities. Historical scale is modest: 53 visiting participants in 2025; the 2024 edition capped attendance at 80, which is not actual attendance. Neither is a 2027 forecast. No evidence supports a 20–120-room block, let alone the whole 237-room hotel.
findings.venueCommitments: CERN, 4/3-006 — TH Conference Room, Building 4, Meyrin site, Switzerland; region: Canton of Geneva. The event page markets the location as Geneva. Geographic category: Meyrin / Geneva Airport-side area, not Geneva city centre and not Founex, Nyon, La Côte or Lausanne. Published programme venue is committed to CERN, not a competing hotel; this does not establish any external lodging commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified recent editions: 15–18 April 2024, Colegio Arzobispo Fonseca, Salón de Actos, Salamanca; 10–13 March 2025, University of Arizona PAS building, room 201, Tucson; 2–5 March 2026, KIAS, Building 1, fifth-floor room 1503, Seoul; 2027 returns to Switzerland at CERN. The official previous-workshops roster establishes international rotation and earlier Bern (2022), Berkeley (2023), and online (2020–2021) editions. Its 2025 date is inconsistent: use the edition-specific 10–13 March dates, not the roster’s 27–30 March. Recurrence is verified, but a fixed Geneva annual cycle is not.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Main SCET workshop, 22–25 March: lodging route remains unconfirmed; no edition-specific hotel block, housing bureau, hotel RFP or host hotel was located. Do not transfer the pre-school commitment to the workshop. Separate Panorama Lectures accommodation page explicitly says participants “need to make their own arrangements for their accommodation (either at the CERN hostel or hotels nearby)” and “a number of rooms at the CERN Hostel have been blocked for this conference.” Forms go to housing.service@cern.ch at least 31 days before arrival; speakers receive separate instructions. Its booking form is headed “From 16th to 20 March 2027”, not 22–25 March. Quantity is unpublished. Off-site alternatives link to a generic CERN list, not edition-specific commitments. Every property on that generic list: Apart hôtel Séjours et Affaires Saint Genis-Pouilly; Best Western Park Hotel; Apart hotel Résidhome Prévessin-Moens; Adagio Genève Mont Blanc; IBIS St Genis-Pouilly Genève; IBIS Budget Saint-Genis-Pouilly Genève; IBIS Budget Genève; Hotel NH Geneva Airport; Hotel Warwick Genève; Movenpick Hotel & Casino Geneva. CERN advises contacting hotels directly for the lowest tariff and MICE Procurement for corporate rates. Historical 2025 only: Ramada by Wyndham Tucson had an explicit participant block; Aloft, The Graduate by Hilton and Marriott University Park were alternatives, not stated blocks. None establishes 2027 availability.
findings.organizationStructure: Scientific workshop hosted through CERN Department of Theoretical Physics, with named scientific chairs and TH secretariat. CERN is a Member-State-governed research organization, not a commercial PCO/DMC or hotel operator acting as event owner. No external PCO, DMC, association legal owner or outsourced housing bureau is identified on the reviewed SCET 2027 page. CERN MICE Procurement is a separate institutional commercial pathway; scientific chair does not equal accommodation buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Verified incumbent for the separate lectures: CERN Hostel, unspecified block size, booking form covering 16–20 March. The generic CERN hotel page publishes 2027 en-suite single rates of CHF 63, creating a likely affordability hurdle for an off-site commercial proposal (inference, not a YOTEL price comparison). Nearby alternatives and some CERN shuttles are listed generically. No sold-out notice, overflow volume, denied lodging requests or unmet external room requirement was found for SCET 2027. Historical student hotel subsidies in 2025 reinforce price sensitivity but do not prove a 2027 subsidy.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First approach TH secretariat at thworkshops.secretariat@cern.ch referencing the 22–25 March workshop separately from the 17–19 March lectures. Ask who coordinates each lodging stream, whether the main workshop has its own CERN Hostel allocation, how many accepted nonlocal attendees need off-site rooms, dates/budget and whether Founex is acceptable with transfers. Request an introduction to Hiba Gerster or Fatima Najeh for the external hotel/corporate-rate pathway; their published contacts are hiba.gerster@cern.ch and fatima.najeh@cern.ch. Only after a demonstrated gap, offer a small, demand-led room allocation with explicit transfer cost; do not reserve speculative inventory or imply an official event partnership.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 attendance application is published as open; this is not an open hotel sourcing process. Meeting venue is confirmed at CERN. Main-workshop external accommodation accessibility remains unknown; the separate lectures already have a CERN Hostel block. Treat SCET as a low-confidence lodging lead until the secretariat confirms unmet demand and willingness to use Founex. The linked lectures’ access notice identifies Gate B closure from 31 August 2026 and Gate A access during works; any transport offer needs current gate validation.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build a CERN TH/MICE supplier relationship for future regional workshops or off-site subgroups; do not pitch relocation of this committed edition. The series rotates internationally, so annual recurrence is not recurring Geneva hotel demand. No 2028 dates, city, venue or procurement opening were established. Capture potential depends on a future regional host, an external-lodging need, accepted pricing and viable transfers.
